Ability Mastery.name: Ability Mastery
Ability Mastery.effect: The Pokémon gains an additional Ability, picked from any Ability it could naturally qualify for.

Accuracy Training.name: Accuracy Training
Accuracy Training.effect: Pick a Move with an AC of 3 or higher; the AC of the target Move is permanently lowered by 1. This Poké Edge may be taken up to three times, each time selecting a different Move.

Advanced Connection.name: Advanced Connection
Advanced Connection.prerequisites: An Ability with the Connection Keyword
Advanced Connection.effect: Choose an Ability with the Connection Keyword that the target has; the Connected Move no longer takes up a Move Slot for the user.

Advanced Mobility.name: Advanced Mobility
Advanced Mobility.effect: Increase one Movement Capability by 2. This Edge may be taken multiple times, but may not be applied more than once to the same Movement Capability.

Attack Conflict.name: Attack Conflict
Attack Conflict.effect: Select Attack or Special Attack. From now on, that Stat does not need to remain higher than Stats it surpasses in Base Relations, and similarly all other Stats surpassed by it do not need to remain lower.

Aura Pulse.name: Aura Pulse
Aura Pulse.prerequisites: Level 30, Aura Reader, owned by a Trainer with Aura Pulse
Aura Pulse.effect: The Pokémon gains the Aura Pulse Capability.

Basic Ranged Attacks.name: Basic Ranged Attacks
Basic Ranged Attacks.prerequisites: One of Firestarter, Fountain, Freezer, Guster, Materializer, or Zapper
Basic Ranged Attacks.effect: Choose one of the Capabilities listed in the prerequisites for this Poké Edge. Struggle Attacks modified by that Capability may now be made at a range of up to 6 meters. This Poké Edge may be taken multiple times, selecting a different Capability each time.

Capability Training.name: Capability Training
Capability Training.effect: Increase Power or a Jump Capability by 1. Capability Training may be taken multiple times, each time increasing a different Capability.

Enticing Bait.name: Enticing Bait
Enticing Bait.effect: When activating the Alluring Capability, the user adds the higher of its Athletics or Focus Ranks to its d20 roll.

Extended Invisibility.name: Extended Invisibility
Extended Invisibility.effect: The user may remain Invisible for up to 8 minutes.

Far Reading.name: Far Reading
Far Reading.effect: The user treats their Focus Rank as 2 higher for the purposes of determining the range of Telepath.

Mixed Power.name: Mixed Power
Mixed Power.prerequisites: Level 10, invested at least 5 Level-Up Stat Points into both Attack and Special Attack
Mixed Power.effect: The user gains the Twisted Power Ability.

Precise Threadings.name: Precise Threadings
Precise Threadings.effect: The user may use their Threaded Capability at a range of 6 meters and with an AC of 3 rather than 6.

Realized Potential.name: Realized Potential
Realized Potential.prerequisites: Level 30, user is an Underdog Pokémon
Realized Potential.effect: Subtract the user’s Species Base Stat Total from 45. The user gains Bonus Stat Points equal to the remainder. These Stat Points must follow Base Stat Relations as normal. If the user evolves to a species with a Base Stat Total 45 or higher, Realized Potential is removed and the Tutor Points refunded.

Seismometer.name: Seismometer
Seismometer.effect: The user’s Tremorsense range is increased by a number of meters equal to their Perception Rank.

Skill Improvement.name: Skill Improvement
Skill Improvement.effect: Rank up one Skill that is currently at or below its default level for the species. This Edge may be taken multiple times, each time selecting a different Skill. If Evolution or another permanent effect would cause the Skill Rank to go beyond 6, this Poké Edge is refunded.

TK Mastery.name: TK Mastery
TK Mastery.effect: The user treats their Focus Rank as 2 higher for the purposes of the Telekinetic Capability.

Trail Sniffer.name: Trail Sniffer
Trail Sniffer.effect: The user gets a bonus to all Perception Rolls to use the Tracker Capability equal to their Focus Rank.

Underdog’s Lessons.name: Underdog’s Lessons
Underdog’s Lessons.effect: Choose a Level-Up Move from one of the user’s Final Evolutions that it can learn at or below its current Level. The user learns that Move as if it were a Level-Up Move and can now learn Moves from TMs, HMs, and Tutoring from the lists of that Final Evolution. Underdog’s Lessons may be taken up to three times but must use the same Final Evolution each time in the case of Pokémon with multiple Final Evolutions.

Underdog’s Strength.name: Underdog’s Strength
Underdog’s Strength.prerequisites: Level 15, user is an Underdog Pokémon
Underdog’s Strength.effect: The user has each of their Base Stats increased by +1. The user may no longer undergo Evolution.
